title: Direct BYOK provider adapter
objective: Bangun adapter BYOK terisolasi yang memanggil provider pilihan workspace secara langsung, tanpa menggunakan akanesia-router.
implementation_steps: Verify provider transport and official SDK signatures
Add tests proving direct routing and request-scoped authorization
Add SSRF defenses, secret redaction, rate/cost budget and timeout
Wire adapter output into common response validator; produce audit proof
acceptance: Loopback/private IP or internal DNS rebinding destinations denied
No API keys in logs or model response
Network failure cannot cause unauthorized fallback
notes: High-risk interface first. Do not use real user keys or production data in tests.
